verdicts.note: Raised goal probability from 5.9% to 9.3% and was stable across seeds.

claim: Two alternative scenarios would have increased the chance of scoring compared with the low-probability shot: a pass to Kai Nakamura would raise the goal probability to 9.3% (from 5.9%), and Mateo Brann being 5 m closer would raise it to 9.8%.
